info.title: FerroMQ HTTP API
info.description: Management API for FerroMQ (`/api/v1`). Default list responses remain bare JSON arrays; pass `?format=page` for `{ items, offset, limit, truncated, total? }`. 4xx/5xx bodies are `{ code, message, details?, request_id }`. Cluster-aggregating endpoints return HTTP 200 with per-node `{ ok, error? }` instead of a single boolean when some nodes fail. Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <http_bearer_token>` remains a static superuser (username `operator`, role `admin`). Dashboard login is `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (HttpOnly cookie `ferromq_session`). Created API keys also authenticate as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` with a bound role. Roles: `admin` (users / keys / audit / broker config write / `?reveal=1` + writes), `operator` (kick / publish / plugin config write+reload / P5 integrations write / P6 alarm ack and cluster writes), `viewer` (read-only, secrets redacted). When neither a bearer token, API key, nor dashboard password is configured, the API stays open (anonymous admin). P4 config `effective` is `hot` (already applied via plugin load_config; not a ferromqd restart), `reload` (file written; call PUT .../config/reload), or `restart_required` (file written; process restart needed). ferromqd is never claimed to hot-restart. P5 adds structured ACL / auth-provider / auto-subscription / topic-rewrite / webhook / bridge APIs on top of P4 plugin-config write. There is no blacklist plugin; GET /api/v1/blacklist documents the gap. P6 diagnostics: alarms are an in-memory bus derived from health/features/unreachable peers (not a native alarm plugin). GET /logs, /trace, /slow-subs return available=false. GET /topic-metrics is route-derived subscriber counts (no per-topic rates). GET /cluster is read-only topology; POST /cluster/join is always 501 (startup-only); POST /cluster/leave works only when ferromq-cluster-raft is active. Cluster write responses always include per-node results.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Hashed API keys; secret shown once on create (admin).

tags.name: Config
tags.description: P4 online configuration: plugin config write/validate/versions and read-first broker mqtt/listener/log.

tags.name: ACL
tags.description: P5 structured ferromq-acl rules (hot-applied via load_config).

tags.description: P5 MQTT client auth plugins (http / jwt), not dashboard login.

tags.name: Blacklist
tags.description: Honest gap: FerroMQ has no blacklist plugin.

tags.description: P5 ferromq-web-hook urls/rules; test is a TCP stub with SSRF checks.

tags.name: Bridges
tags.description: P5 bridge plugins: status/attrs + P4 config write + load/unload.

tags.name: Alarms
tags.description: P6 in-memory alarm bus derived from health/features/unreachable peers. Not a native alarm plugin; lost on restart.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: P6 gap: no log collector. GET returns available=false.

tags.name: Topic metrics
tags.description: P6 route-derived subscriber counts. Per-topic rates are not collected.

tags.description: P6 topology + membership. Join/leave only if ferromq-cluster-raft Plugin::send exists; otherwise 501 with per-node results.

get.summary: Swagger UI for the OpenAPI document

post.description: Verifies username/password (bcrypt). If no users exist yet and the credentials match `dashboard_admin_*` (or viewer) config, the first login bootstraps that user. Sets `ferromq_session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure when `dashboard_cookie_secure`). In-memory sessions are not shared across cluster nodes.

get.description: Session cookie, bearer operator, or anonymous admin when auth is not configured.

post.summary: Change the current session user's password
post.description: Requires a dashboard session (not bearer/anonymous). New password is stored as a bcrypt hash.
Creates the configured `dashboard_admin_username` (and optional viewer) when no users exist. Does not accept a caller-chosen password.

get.description: Admin only. Passwords are never returned.

post.description: Admin only. Password is stored as a bcrypt hash.
Admin only. Sessions for the user are revoked. Cannot disable the last enabled admin or the current user.

get.description: Admin only. Secrets are never listed.

post.description: Admin only. The plaintext secret (`fmqk_<id>_<random>`) is returned **once**. It is stored as SHA-256. Use `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` on `/api/v1`. Role defaults to `operator`.

get.description: Admin only. Newest first. In-memory ring buffer; optional JSONL file via `audit_file`. Filters: `action`, `username`, `success`.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exact action filter (login, login_failed, kick_client, publish, plugin_load, api_key_create, ...)

get.summary: Basic information of every cluster node

200.description: Per-node broker objects; failed peers are ClusterNodeError
Per-node status; failed peers are ClusterNodeError

get.summary: Cluster feature flags plus consistency summary (menu gating)
get.description: `enabled` is the OR of each flag across reachable nodes and is intended for dashboard menu gating. `nodes[]` uses structured `{ ok, error? }` rather than a bare error string. Unreachable nodes increment `failed_count` and set `partial: true`.
Default body is `{ items, has_more }`. `?format=page` adds `offset`, `limit`, `truncated`, and optional `total`.

delete.summary: Delete a retained message by exact topic

post.summary: Unsubscribe a session from a topic

get.description: Default: array of `{ ok, node, plugins }` (or `{ ok: false, node, plugins: [], error }`). `?format=page` wraps the array.

get.summary: Read a plugin config (secrets redacted unless reveal=1 and admin)

200.description: Plugin config JSON (password/token/private_key/secret/jwt keys redacted by default)

put.description: Accepts a JSON object, `{ "toml": "..." }`, or raw TOML. Atomically writes `{plugins.dir}/{plugin}.toml`, keeps last N backups, optionally applies via plugin `load_config` (`?apply=reload`, default). Returns a diff and `effective`: `hot` (already applied in-process via load_config — not a ferromqd restart), `reload` (call PUT .../config/reload), or `restart_required` (immutable / load_config failed / not initialized).

post.summary: Dry-run validate a plugin config without writing

get.description: Reads this node's ferromq.toml. Secrets are redacted unless `?reveal=1` and admin. Writing mqtt/listener/log never hot-restarts ferromqd (`effective` is always `restart_required`).

get.summary: Read one ferromq.toml section (mqtt / listener / log)

put.description: Merges the JSON/TOML body into that section of ferromq.toml. Always returns `effective=restart_required`. Does not claim a hot restart of ferromqd.

post.summary: Restore a ferromq.toml backup (admin). Still restart_required.

put.summary: Reload a plugin config from disk
Load / start a plugin on a node
Unload / stop a plugin on a node

get.description: Array of `{ ok: true, node, stats }` or `{ ok: false, node, error }`.

200.description: Per-node metrics; failed peers use `{ ok: false, node, error }`

get.description: Reads ferromq-acl.toml. Passwords in who objects are `***` unless `?reveal=1` and admin.

put.summary: Update ACL settings and/or replace rules
put.description: Writes ferromq-acl.toml and applies via plugin load_config when possible (`effective=hot`).

delete.summary: Delete an ACL rule by index

get.description: ferromq-auth-http and ferromq-auth-jwt only. Not dashboard login.

put.summary: Write auth provider config via P4

post.description: http: TCP connect after SSRF checks (no HTTP request). jwt: local hmac_secret / public_key file check. Not a live IdP probe.

get.description: FerroMQ does not ship a blacklist plugin. Returns available=false and ACL connect-rule alternatives.

get.summary: Webhook urls, rules, and plugin attrs
get.description: URL userinfo is redacted unless reveal=1 and admin. queue_capacity / concurrency_limit need a plugin restart (plugin docs).

post.description: SSRF: only http/https; blocks loopback/private/metadata unless allow_private=1 and admin.

get.description: In-memory bus refreshed from health, features, and node reachability. available=true means the bus exists, not that FerroMQ has a native alarm plugin.
No log collector. Returns available=false and points at GET /broker/config/log.

501.description: No trace plugin; details.nodes not used (local gap)

get.description: available=true with kind=route_derived. Per-topic publish/deliver rates are not collected. $SYS topics are listed only when ferromq-sys-topic is loaded.
mode is standalone | raft | broadcast. membership.join/leave say whether write APIs exist. GET /brokers and GET /nodes also include an additive cluster object.

post.description: Always 501. Raft::join is consumed at ferromq-cluster-raft init from raft_peer_addrs. Response details.nodes is a per-node result array.
Calls Plugin::send({op:leave}) → Mailbox::leave on the local node. Otherwise 501. Always returns per-node results.

bearerAuth.description: Required only when `http_bearer_token` is set in the plugin config.

RevealSecrets.name: reveal
RevealSecrets.description: If `1`/`true`, return unredacted secrets. Admin only; others get 403.

ApplyMode.name: apply
ApplyMode.description: `reload` (default) calls plugin `load_config` after write. `none` writes the file only.

Limit.name: _limit
Limit.description: Max rows. `0` or omitted uses plugin `max_row_limit` (default 10000).

LimitAlias.name: limit
LimitAlias.description: Alias of `_limit` (used by `/retains` as the canonical name).

Offset.name: _offset
Offset.description: Rows to skip after the backend fetch.

FormatPage.name: format
FormatPage.description: Set to `page` to wrap a list as `{ items, offset, limit, truncated, total? }` instead of a bare array. Default is the historical array body.

Reveal.name: reveal
Reveal.description: If `1`/`true`, return unredacted secrets. Admin only; others get 403.

Apply.name: apply
Apply.description: `reload` (default) calls plugin `load_config` after write. `none` writes the file only.

Format.name: format
Format.description: Set to `page` to wrap a list.

NodeQuery.name: node
NodeQuery.description: Target node id. Defaults to the HTTP API local node.

AllowPrivate.name: allow_private
AllowPrivate.description: Allow loopback/private IPs on connectivity tests. Admin only.

XRowCount.description: Number of rows in this response (`items.length` for page / retains).

XTruncated.description: `true` when the result was cut off by `_limit` / `max_row_limit`.

XRequestId.description: Correlation id. Echoed from the request header when present.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer token / session cookie

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but role cannot perform this action (viewer vs operator vs admin)

ClientList.description: Bare array by default; `{ items, ... }` when `format=page`.

SubscriptionList.description: Bare array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

RouteList.description: Bare array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

PluginList.description: Bare plugin array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

code.description: Same value as the HTTP status code

total.description: Present only when the backend knows the full count

node.description: Present on stats/metrics (`{ id }`) and plugins (`integer`)

Features.description: Runtime capability flags. A flag is true when the backing implementation is loaded and enabled. Used by the dashboard for menu gating via FeaturesSummary.enabled.

retain.description: Retained messages (`ferromq-retainer`). Gates the Retains menu.

EffectiveMode.description: hot = already applied via plugin load_config (not a ferromqd restart). reload = file written, call PUT .../config/reload. restart_required = process restart needed; ferromqd is never hot-restarted.

ConfigWriteBody.description: Either the config object itself, or `{ "toml": "..." }`.

AclRuleInput.description: Structured rule or `{ "raw": ["allow", "all"] }` / a raw array.

raft.description: Plugin::send({op:status}) payload when raft is active

ClusterWriteResult.description: Cluster membership write. Always includes a per-node result array. On 501 the same shape is in Error.details.

secret.description: Plaintext secret, shown only on create. Use as Bearer token.

bearerAuth.description: Static `http_bearer_token` (role=admin, username=operator) or a created API key secret (bound role).

sessionCookie.name: ferromq_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login.
